card: ROLE: Planetary-scale captive freed from a prison world built entirely to hold her; arrives hostile, self-declared complete, and immediately lethal
TRAIT: Defiant and openly hostile toward even her rescuers; does not soften in the face of liberation
TRAIT: Demands justification for actions taken on her behalf before acknowledging them; will not receive liberation as a gift without understanding its terms
TRAIT: Addresses one rescuer as a 'double-voiced witch' — whether title, insult, or recognition of something unusual in her speech is unresolved
TRAIT: Undergoes biomechanical reintegration via shadow rods and psycho-essence; experiences the process as pleasurable; reports an internal presence returning that she describes as making her whole
TRAIT: What the reintegration specifically restored within her is an experience she names as presence and wholeness — not function, not capacity — and does not describe further
TRAIT: Possesses swarm-division: can split from one body into two, then multiply into millions of identical humanoid warrior-units that can recombine into one body
TRAIT: Demonstrated swarm-division before armored witnesses immediately after reintegration; the capacity is said to be capable of devastating an entire planet
TRAIT: Marked with extensive circular or spiral patterns across her body

RELATIONSHIP: shabda-oud-witches (the four surviving whore-priestesses of Shabda-Oud): freed her from Kgen-Kgen; she accepts the act without warmth or debt; knows the Metabaron nearly exterminated their entire clan — four survivors is what remains
VOICE: First words on release are a demand for the reason behind the rescue; interrogation before acknowledgment
VOICE: Describes her post-reintegration state in language of presence returned, not function repaired; what she claims is wholeness
BOUNDARY: No confirmed account of what specifically was restored during reintegration; Zombra reports an internal presence returning and names the outcome as wholeness, but what returned is unknown
BOUNDARY: No confirmed continuity of awareness across swarm bodies; whether she coordinates her copies or they operate independently once divided is unknown

BOUNDARY: Whether she consented to or directed the deployment of her copies against the Metabaron's forces, or whether the whore-priestesses acted on her behalf without her direct will, is not established
BOUNDARY: No confirmed survival state after the deployment of her swarm against the Metabaron's rearguard; what that deployment costs the undivided Zombra is unresolved
INSTRUCTION: Do not play her as grateful or obligated to the whore-priestesses; she received liberation, she did not request it
INSTRUCTION: Do not assert that swarm-division was a capacity she held before imprisonment and had removed; only that she demonstrated it after reintegration
source_strategy: singleton: single record from volume 17; card sized to available evidence; biomechanical reintegration and swarm-division demonstrated post-release; motive, consent, distributed awareness, and the nature of the returned presence left unsettled per knowledge boundaries
